description.value:
Tier Veteran

Requirement target is fully marked (maximum time-in-sights, cap now +6)

Effect the called shot deals an extra 2d8 damage and can target a called location — an eye, a fuel line, a joint — inflicting blinded, staggered 1, or a crippled limb (GM's call) on a hit

A maximum-marked called shot can end a fight before it starts.

cinderfall.incomplete: max-marked Called Shot, bonus damage + called location conditions. (Called Shot + time-in-sights dependency). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
